- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Cedar wood is a popular choice for outdoor projects due to its natural resistance to rot, decay, and insect damage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A well-maintained cedar wood trellis can last 10 to 15 years in harsh conditions, 15 to 20 years in moderate conditions, and 20 to 25 years or more in ideal conditions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To extend the life of a cedar wood trellis, use a waterproof sealant, apply a UV-resistant finish, and regularly inspect and clean the trellis.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Marigolds repel nematodes, whiteflies, and aphids, while sunflowers attract beneficial insects like bees and butterflies.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The user should consider their climate, plant compatibility, and the type of beneficial insects they want to attract when choosing flowers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To create a beneficial insect-friendly garden, diversify plants, provide food and shelter, avoid pesticides, and maintain a healthy ecosystem.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Common beneficial insects include bees, butterflies, ladybugs, parasitic wasps, and ground beetles.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Common pests include aphids, whiteflies, and caterpillars.
- [EVENT] The user is thinking of adding a small pond to their garden to attract more beneficial insects and create a habitat for them.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A small pond can attract beneficial insects, provide a habitat for wildlife, and create a soothing atmosphere in the garden.
